political science and one from IR that have come into question in recent times? - I said that in 
International Relations, I think Liberal Institutionalism could be a good contender, because 
multilateral institutions like the WTO and UN seem to be on the back foot, and we see a shift 
towards protectionism and minilateralism. As for Political Science, sir, I think Communism as a 
concept has always been under question, especially considering the paradox modern communist 
countries exhibit - they practice authoritarianism under the garb of communism, and end up 
liberalising their economies  
5. Okay good. Have you heard of Populism? Do you think it has always been in practice or is it a 
new phenomenon? Can you give an example from the past and the present? - Sir, I think 
populism in varying degrees has been in practice ever since democracy, and especially 
representative democracy have existed. It becomes imperative to cater to the demands of the 
people, and eventually numbers end up mattering a lot for accruing power. As for examples, the 
opening up of the EIC for public investment by the British was a populist measure. And today sir 
the rise of vote bank politics could be a case in point (I purposefully didn’t cite specific examples 
here. Figured if they wanted to go in that direction they would prod me on their own)

mentioned the head of delegation

Interview Transcripts (CSPT-2025), [Jan 6, 2026 at 8:06 AM] 
Name - Chester Bennington  
Board - Sheel Vardhan sir  
Duration - 21-22 minutes  
DAF Keywords asked - Karnataka, Yelahanka, EEE, Sociology, Work based (AI powered 
Dashcamera), Nu-metal Music (Linkin Park), Kho-Kho.  
80% of the conversation was DAF based.  
Chairperson -  
Good Afternoon, welcome to the conversation.  
You have mentioned follower of Nu-metal music of Linkin Park - Do you know Mike Shinoda?  
What does he do? Does he rap/sing/ compose?  
Linkin park is coming to Bangalore in January, are you going?  
What was the ticket price? What is the highest ticket price?  
Nu-metal includes lot of shouting and screaming, do you think it’s good?  
So you are working, (gave few seconds of monologue) - who are gig workers?  
What do we have to do which they are lacking? ( I answered social security need - he mentioned 
it’s a wide topic, what inside that? I mentioned PF, contracts etc - he added what about working 
condition, wage- I agreed to all)  
Coming from Yelahanka - he asked about air show (asked if I’ve seen rafale in action (said no, 
missed this year)) 
What is the last activity that is performed in air show (couldn’t recollect) - then he said about surya 
Kiran.  
Member 1 (female)  
Do you think DBT for women is good? 
Don’t you think it has to be conditional?  
What needs to be done for women empowerment? (Mentioned POSH in my last point)  
What is the main feature of POSH?  
Member 2  
What does your company do and what is your role?  
What are the main features of AI dashcam?  
How does the camera alert the driver? (Mentioned edge and cloud here)  
What is cloud computing?  
Where does the data get stored?  
Recently, there was an issue regarding morphing of videos/images from a social media, what is 
that? (Mentioned grok from twitter)  
Do you think AI regulation needs to be there? 
Member 3  
Where are we in semiconductor?  
Do you think India started late in semiconductor? (He said, you can be honest here - I agreed to 
him and added but we are doing good by keeping up the pace through various initiatives)  
What are the initiatives for Semiconductor?  
There are 3 places we are setting up fabs where are they? ( mentioned Assam by Tata, couldn’t 
recollect others, he said no worries and said about Gujarat)  
Why does games like Kho Kho is lagging behind?

Member 4  
From sociology, who said “man is a social animal?”  
Is man really a social animal? Do you think animals can survive in isolation. 
(Asked 1 more, not able to recollect)  
Chair person again -  
“Chester, do you want to ask us anything?  
You can ask anything” ( emphasised more on word “anything” here with bit of head movement 
-encouraging to ask)  
“Sir, we can have conversation on international relations”  
Sir - there are so many disruptions in the world today, when you wake up from bed, thinking 
keeping this in mind, what makes you feel anxious about?  
Thank you, your interview is over you may leave.  
Mocks given - Shankar, La-excellence, Rajkumar and JICE, Grace IAS, Samutkarsh(samkalp)
(closest to real interview).

be in the civil services. (Everyone was smiling and sir remarked it’s a good thing)

*Sir, there are multiple reasons for this. One is to ensure the lawful use of banking services by the 
lawful people.  
Another one is that it helps in effectively supervising the bank accounts like Suspicious 
Transactions are reported if anything unusual happens or of they are being used mule accounts. 
For example, if in the current account opening if I’m showing my yearly income of about 5 lakh 
and suddenly I get 1 crore in my account. That generates an alert whether the account is being 
used for illegal activities or is it a genuine transaction. So customer profiling through KYC 
becomes a useful tool for safe banking.  
M2: Okay so you mentioned about mule accounts. Why are they used? 
*Sir, mule accounts acts as the rented bank accounts which are used for illegal transactions 
involving a fraud or a money laundering.  
M2: Okay, so recently RBI is reducing its repo rate, why is it doing so and is it getting passed on 
to the customers?  
*Sir, Repo rate acts as one of the quantitative tool in hand of the RBI for liquidity management. In 
the first half of  FY2025-26, India recorded a growth rate of 8.0% and the inflation of about 3.3% 
was well within the targeted range that the MPC has set that is 4+_2%. So it was a prudent step 
to push for increasing liquidity in the market while supporting the growth perspective in this 
unique goldilocks period in India. Sadly, it’s not passed on to the customers immediately and 
proportionally . So it’s a challenge in transmission of policy rates to the customers.

*Sir, the there is no interest paid on the deposits in the current account but when it comes to the 
savings deposits, it is less because the savings deposits acts one of the source of liquidity for the
